svg.title: Workstreams
svg.desc: Lane: F0 foundation: split, engine, daemon, registry, core nav, Owner: lead, Files: Sources/main.swift, Store.swift, OneShot.swift, SignIn.swift, Engine.swift, Registry.swift, Server.swift, CoreCommands.swift, Depends on: none; Lane: W1 interaction: snapshot, refs, actions, input, upload, dialogs, Owner: agent, Files: Sources/Interact*.swift, Depends on: F0; Lane: W2 capture: screenshot, pdf, text/markdown/links/html, console, network, blocking, viewport, Owner: agent, Files: Sources/Capture*.swift, Depends on: F0; Lane: W3 MCP: protocol, tool schemas, image content, Claude Code setup, Owner: agent, Files: Sources/MCP.swift, Depends on: F0; Lane: W4 tests, benchmarks, invisibility checks, Owner: agent, Files: tests/, bench/, Depends on: F0, then W1 to W3; Lane: W5 README, docs, llms.txt, skill, Owner: agent, Files: README.md, docs/, skill/, assets/, Depends on: W1 to W3; Lane: Release: CI, packaging, Owner: agent, Files: Makefile, .github/, packaging/, Depends on: none
